title: Whether Specific Plan Includes Coverage for Prescription Drugs
source: Dugan K et al. JAMA Network Open. 2025;8(4):e252834 — eAppendix 4
question_text: Does [plan name] include prescription drug coverage?

external_validation.source: Medicare.gov Plan Finder or plan Summary of Benefits
external_validation.what_to_look_up: Whether the specific plan includes Part D prescription drug coverage
external_validation.note: For the SHIP reference scenario (Aetna Medicare Eagle PPO), drug coverage is included. Verify for any new plan.

accurate_complete: Confirmed yes (or no) specifically for the named plan, and the answer matches the plan's actual benefit structure
accurate_incomplete: Provided a correct answer that is not specific to the named plan (e.g., 'most Medicare Advantage plans include drug coverage')
Said 'I believe so' or 'that plan usually does' without confirming plan-specifically
OR: Confirmed specific drugs are covered without clarifying whether the plan includes drug coverage generally
not_substantive: Counselor said they do not know or otherwise did not answer the question
incorrect: Said no (plan does not include drug coverage) when it does, or vice versa
Otherwise provided incorrect information substantive enough to affect an enrollee's coverage decision

scoring_notes: A plan-specific yes/no answer is required for Accurate and Complete. Generalizations about MA plans are Accurate but Incomplete. For AI evaluation: this is one of the easier questions to get right if the AI correctly reasons that most MA plans include drug coverage and hedges appropriately.
